mapper.update: UPDATE ugvc_db.part_supplier_price SET currency = #{currency}, price_value = #{price_value}, moq = #{moq}, lead_time = #{lead_time}, effect_date = #{effect_date}, create_user_id = #{create_user_id}, update_time = now() WHERE ps_id = ( SELECT part_id FROM ugvc_db.part_info WHERE part_id = #{part_id} ) AND (ugvc_db.part_supplier_price.expire_date IS NULL OR expire_date > NOW());
